method.name: empirical-bayes-base-rate-v0
method.description_en: Historical base rates since 1990 per country, shrunk towards the global distribution (empirical Bayes) and weighted towards recent years. Armed conflicts use a two-state model: for ongoing conflicts the probability that the conflict is still active at the end of the horizon, otherwise the probability of onset. This is an outside-view baseline without current-news adjustment and is not yet calibrated.
method.description_ru: Исторические частоты с 1990 года по каждой стране, сглаженные к мировому распределению (эмпирический Байес) с повышенным весом последних лет. Для вооружённых конфликтов — модель двух состояний: для идущего конфликта это вероятность, что он ещё будет активен в конце горизонта, иначе — вероятность начала. Это базовая оценка «внешнего взгляда» без учёта текущих новостей; калибровка ещё не проводилась.

event_types.resolution_en: Mass Mobilization (Clark & Regan): at least one protest against the government with more than 10,000 participants in a calendar year. The dataset ends in 2020, so the base rate describes 1990–2020; recent months are shown by news signs (unrest) and are not yet scored. Countries outside the dataset have no estimate.

event_types.source: Mass Mobilization (Clark & Regan), protests of 10,000+ people, 1990–2020

event_types.resolution_en: At least one of: (1) the head of state or government leaves office outside the normal schedule; (2) an early national election is called; (3) impeachment passes at least one chamber; (4) a nationwide state of emergency or martial law for political reasons; (5) a coup attempt or irregular change of power. Probabilities are not yet computed: there is no history of these events for all countries for 2000–2025 of sufficient quality. Current events are detected from the news.
